column1: # Perl fact counters: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted over the whole file. The
# [ignore] lines run first: they blank POD, everything after __END__ / __DATA__, heredoc bodies and
# comment lines (keeping the line breaks), so a sub named in the documentation or in a usage text does
# not count. Counts are regex heuristics: a sub generated with eval or a glob assignment is not seen.
